chapters.title: The First Shift
lines: Bruno MEGAPLEX — 11:47 PM.
First shift as the night guard. First mistake: showing up.
You signed the contract. The rules were written by something else.
And in the STELLAR DAYCARE... something is singing a lullaby.
*click* — Hello? Hello-hello?... The new guard? This is RULO, from the last shift.
Listen, I don't have much time. Rule one: the animatronics WANDER at night. Something in their servos... don't ask.
Your FLASHLIGHT is on the Security Office desk, west of the lobby. Grab it before you take another single step.
Rule two: the STELLAR DAYCARE, west of the atrium, is... occupied. MOON, the caretaker. It can barely see, but it hears EVERYTHING.
We've heard noises in the ball pit tonight. Check the bottom of it. And walk along the edge: the balls sound like fireworks.
If the lullaby stops... it has already heard you. Crouch, hold still for a moment, and walk back to the lobby. Don't run.
Finish the shift alive and we'll talk tomorrow. A hundred and twenty dollars a week. Some paycheck, huh?

objectives.title: Pick up your FLASHLIGHT at the Security Office
Inspect the ball pit at the STELLAR DAYCARE
objectives.hint: West of the atrium — walk along the edge of the balls

objectives.title: Return alive to the Security Office
objectives.hint: Rulo will lock the gates as you pass

chapters.title: Bonnie Bowl
lines: The daycare is behind you. The whole MEGAPLEX is still dark.
The bowling alley has its pinsetters fried.
And the rabbit from the arcade has learned to use the vents.
Still alive? Good. Listen: in the SECURITY OFFICE on the South Promenade I left a tablet with the cameras. With it, you'll see them coming. Take it.
The bowling alley has three fried pinsetters. Three. The boss wants the alley alive for tomorrow's event.
And yes: it's a TRIAL. The lights will die, and she will come for you. If she catches you, you wake up on the promenade. Try again.
Bonnie — the rabbit — comes out of the Arcade Hall. The flashlight freezes her if you hit her straight in the face.
Before you go in, collect 3 golden tokens from the arcade. You'll need them for the machines.

objectives.title: CLEAR THE TRIAL: Bowling Alley
objectives.hint: Enter the alley and restart the 3 pinsetters

chapters.title: The Food Court
lines: The bowling alley sings. The night goes on.
The Food Court must open tomorrow with all three stands running.
The chicken is already circling the tables. And she can smell the oven.
Chica — the chicken — has been hunting in the Food Court since tonight. Burnt pizza and feathers come before her.
Three fried stands: PIZZA, FRIES and ICE CREAM. Restart all three. The service notes say they reboot on their own... mostly.
Chica does not dodge the flashlight. She hears EVERYTHING. Crouch with Ctrl and never run in there.
When you're done, swing by Pirate's Cove. Someone left a sign there... and something moves behind the curtain.

objectives.title: Investigate Pirate's Cove
objectives.hint: West end of the West Promenade

chapters.title: Pirate's Cove
lines: The Cove attraction has been shut down for years.
The fox behind the curtain has started to really run.
Flip the 3 switches. And never stop moving.
Foxy. The fox. He's the fastest, and the only one the mask can't fool. If he chases you: sprint and weave.
The flashlight REPELS him — straight in the face, no mercy, until he backs off.
Three switches on the south wall of the Cove, in order. If he catches you, you respawn on the promenade. His favorite game: cat and fox.
When the attraction roars, he goes back behind his curtain. He always comes back. You'll never know if he's sleeping... or pretending.

objectives.title: Recover the ship's tape
objectives.hint: Near the pirate ship in the Cove

chapters.title: The Generators
lines: The master fuse is blown. The whole grid depends on it.
The complex's power will be decided in the Generator Room.
Order 3 · 1 · 4 · 2. And everyone wide awake.
The note I left in the Electrical Room says it: 3, 1, 4, 2. The master fuse order for the Generator Room.
The generator door is east of the South Promenade. I unlocked it for you. Don't ask how.
One more thing: there's a GOLDEN SUIT in the South Technical Room, right under your office. If you feel it watching you... run. Don't fight. RUN.
When the grid comes back, the lobby's outer doors will unlock. Run south. Don't look back.

chapters.title: The Hallway of Sounds
lines: *click* …Rulo again. The grid is failing zone by zone.
The whole TECHNICAL GALLERY is pitch black. Only the red emergency lights are left.
You can't see what's behind each service door... but you CAN hear it.
Listen to the sound at each door. I'll tell you which one to enter. If you get it wrong...
...well. You already know the ones inside. Good luck.
*click* Still there? It's Rulo. The technical gallery just went dark.
Six service doors, and only ONE way to know what's behind them: SOUND.
A FAN hums where nobody is. POTS AND PANS clang where Chica is tearing the kitchen apart.
If you hear heavy footsteps or a metallic laugh... NOT that door. Don't open it. Ever.
I'll walk you through round by round. Listen before you move. Trust your ears, not your eyes.

chapters.title: The Burning Basement
lines: The night has already piled three trials on your back.
And now the MEGAPLEX smells of burnt plastic.
The MEGA DAYCARE is on fire. And MOON is singing in the flames.
*click* …Rulo. You found it. THE BASEMENT. What's left of the ORIGINAL pizzeria.
The fire has been eating it for YEARS. And something with a moon for a face lives down there.
Seven fires, seven extinguishers. Put them all out, and the light will change everything.
When the SUN rises... RUN TO THE LOBBY EXIT. Don't look back.
Whatever you were before tonight... it ends HERE.

objectives.title: KILL THE INFERNO: 7 extinguishers
objectives.hint: Mega Daycare — 7 fires, not one less
